metadata.description: Curated primary sources for production agent systems: architecture, protocols, tool design, evaluation, observability, and economics.
metadata.title: AI Agents - Sources

standards_and_governance.name: EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
standards_and_governance.relevance: Regulatory baseline for risk classification, transparency, documentation, and controls affecting agent systems.

standards_and_governance.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
standards_and_governance.relevance: Governance and risk management framework for production AI systems.

standards_and_governance.name: NIST Generative AI Profile (AI 600-1)
standards_and_governance.relevance: GenAI-specific profile aligned to NIST AI RMF; useful for controls, logging, and deployment planning.

standards_and_governance.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
standards_and_governance.relevance: Threat categories for prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse, and agent abuse scenarios.

standards_and_governance.name: NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
standards_and_governance.relevance: Secure development baseline relevant for tool implementation, supply chain, and deployment practices.

standards_and_governance.name: ISO/IEC 42001
standards_and_governance.relevance: AI management system standard for organizational governance and continuous improvement.

standards_and_governance.name: CVE-2026-30623 — Command injection via Anthropic MCP SDK (stdio)
standards_and_governance.relevance: CVE record + mitigation context for the MCP stdio command-injection class. Pair with the OX Security systemic advisory. April 2026.

protocols_and_interoperability.name: Agent Skills Specification
protocols_and_interoperability.relevance: Official skill packaging specification for SKILL.md structure, metadata, and progressive disclosure.

protocols_and_interoperability.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Introduction
protocols_and_interoperability.relevance: High-level overview of MCP for tool and resource integration.

protocols_and_interoperability.name: MCP Transport Specification
protocols_and_interoperability.relevance: Primary source for MCP transport guidance, including stdio and Streamable HTTP. Current stable: 2025-11-25.

protocols_and_interoperability.name: MCP Authorization Specification
protocols_and_interoperability.relevance: Primary source for MCP authorization, OAuth 2.1, and OpenID Connect guidance for remote servers. Current stable: 2025-11-25.

protocols_and_interoperability.name: Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol Overview
protocols_and_interoperability.relevance: Primary source for agent cards, task handoffs, and agent-to-agent interoperability. A2A v1.0 under Linux Foundation governance. Verified 2026-06-09.

protocols_and_interoperability.name: Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol Specification
protocols_and_interoperability.relevance: Full A2A v1.0 specification: tasks, messages, artifacts, agent cards, JSON-RPC/gRPC/HTTP-REST protocol bindings, security. Verified 2026-06-09.

protocols_and_interoperability.name: MAST: A Multi-Agent System Taxonomy (arXiv:2503.13657)
protocols_and_interoperability.relevance: Canonical MAST taxonomy: 14 failure modes across 3 categories. Original Cemri et al. distribution ≈ Specification/System Design 41.8%, Inter-Agent Misalignment 36.9%, Task Verification 21.3% (figures vary across secondary write-ups applying MAST to other trace sets — verify against the primary PDF/HTML before quoting). NeurIPS 2025 Datasets & Benchmarks track. Re-verified 2026-07-11.

protocols_and_interoperability.name: JSON Schema
protocols_and_interoperability.relevance: Schema standard for tool I/O validation, handoff contracts, and structured outputs.

protocols_and_interoperability.name: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions for GenAI
protocols_and_interoperability.relevance: Standardized telemetry fields for LLM calls, tool calls, and agent tracing.

protocols_and_interoperability.name: OX Security — Systemic MCP STDIO RCE advisory (CVE-2026-30623)
protocols_and_interoperability.relevance: Verified by-design config->OS-command execution in official MCP SDK stdio interface; Anthropic confirmed by-design and declined a protocol fix. Load-bearing for MCP host sandboxing guidance. Multi-source corroborated (The Register, CSA, Infosecurity, CVE-2026-30623), April 2026.

protocols_and_interoperability.name: MCP 2026 Roadmap & 2026-07-28 Release Candidate
protocols_and_interoperability.relevance: Primary source (MCP blog). 2025-11-25 remains current stable as of June 2026; a 2026-07-28 revision (largest since launch) is in release candidate: stateless HTTP core, MCP Apps (server-rendered UIs), Tasks extension (long-running work), OAuth/OIDC-aligned auth, formal deprecation policy. Build on 2025-11-25 today; track blog for ratification.

implementation_docs_and_playbooks.name: The Machine that Builds the Machine — Symphony (@daniel_mac8)
implementation_docs_and_playbooks.relevance: Deep dive on OpenAI's Symphony — an open-source Elixir-based orchestrator that polls Linear, spawns Codex agents in isolated workspaces with 300-line Jinja2 workflow templates, self-reviews PRs, and manages full issue lifecycle. Demonstrates outcome-based vs prompt-based agent paradigm at 10-agent concurrency: 26 tasks, 27 PRs, 32K LOC in 36 hours.

implementation_docs_and_playbooks.name: OpenAI Building Agents
implementation_docs_and_playbooks.relevance: Official playbook for agent design, tools, orchestration, evals, MCP/connectors, and operations.

implementation_docs_and_playbooks.name: Anthropic Claude Code Best Practices
implementation_docs_and_playbooks.relevance: Official guidance for context, subagents, memory, and code-agent operating patterns.

implementation_docs_and_playbooks.name: Anthropic Writing Tools for Agents
implementation_docs_and_playbooks.relevance: Primary source for tool design: narrow tools, strong descriptions, examples, and predictable side-effect boundaries.

implementation_docs_and_playbooks.name: Anthropic Tool Use Documentation
implementation_docs_and_playbooks.relevance: Official provider reference for tool calling, tool schemas, and tool-use orchestration.

implementation_docs_and_playbooks.name: LangGraph Documentation
implementation_docs_and_playbooks.relevance: Reference implementation for stateful workflow agents, checkpoints, and human-in-the-loop patterns.

implementation_docs_and_playbooks.name: OpenAI Evals
implementation_docs_and_playbooks.relevance: Reference tooling for evaluation harnesses and regression tests.

implementation_docs_and_playbooks.name: OpenTelemetry Documentation
implementation_docs_and_playbooks.relevance: Implementation reference for distributed tracing, metrics, and logs in production systems.

framework_docs.name: OpenAI Agents SDK for Python

framework_docs.name: OpenAI Agents SDK for JavaScript

framework_docs.name: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)

framework_docs.name: Pydantic AI

framework_docs.name: AWS Bedrock Agents
framework_docs.relevance: Official managed-agent documentation for AWS environments.

framework_docs.name: Microsoft Agent Framework Overview
framework_docs.relevance: Official overview for Microsoft's agent framework; use this to verify current lifecycle, language support, and Azure positioning.

framework_docs.name: Anthropic Claude Agent SDK
framework_docs.relevance: Official Anthropic SDK docs for code agents, MCP integration, tools, computer use, and subagents.

framework_docs.name: LlamaIndex Workflows
framework_docs.relevance: Official workflow and orchestration docs for retrieval-heavy agent systems.

framework_docs.name: Spring AI Reference
framework_docs.relevance: Official Java/Kotlin agent framework: ChatClient, Advisors, ToolCallback, A2A integration, AutoMemoryTools.

framework_docs.name: Semantic Kernel → Microsoft Agent Framework Migration Guide
framework_docs.relevance: Official migration path; SK is in maintenance, MAF is the forward path. Verify before starting any greenfield SK work.

framework_docs.name: SmolAgents Documentation
framework_docs.relevance: Official lightweight agent framework documentation from Hugging Face.

framework_docs.name: Agno Documentation
framework_docs.relevance: Official documentation for Agno's agent runtime, workflows, memory, and integrations.

framework_docs.name: Haystack Documentation
framework_docs.relevance: Official documentation for Haystack pipelines and agent components.

framework_docs.name: DSPy Documentation
framework_docs.relevance: Official docs for declarative prompt/program optimization and agentic modules.

framework_docs.name: OWL (CAMEL-AI)
framework_docs.relevance: Multi-agent cooperation framework from CAMEL-AI that tops GAIA benchmark; reference for agent team coordination and real-world task completion benchmarks.

framework_docs.name: Dify
framework_docs.relevance: Open-source LLM app builder combining workflows, RAG pipelines, and agents in a single platform; reference for integrated agentic application architecture patterns.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: OpenAI API Pricing
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: Current pricing for OpenAI models and tools; required for ROI and budget calculations.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: Anthropic API Pricing
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: Current pricing for Anthropic models and platform usage; required for ROI and budget calculations.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: Google AI Pricing
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: Current pricing for Gemini-family models and related services.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: Anthropic: Building Effective Agents
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: High-signal guidance on when to use workflows vs agents and how to keep agent systems simple.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: karpathy/autoresearch
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: Reference implementation for autonomous improvement loops: bounded modification surface, fixed eval metric, git-as-experiment-ledger. Defines the research/experiment agent architecture.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: Ole Lehmann: Skill Optimization with Autonomous Loops
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: Generalizes autoresearch to prompt/skill improvement: yes/no scoring checklist, agent loops change → test → keep/revert until 95%+. Case study: 56% → 92% in 4 rounds.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: a16z: AI Agents Primer
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: External perspective on agent economics, market tradeoffs, and operating-model assumptions.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: Hallucination Leaderboard (Vectara)
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: Benchmark reference for hallucination-rate comparisons and risk discussions.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: ccusage — Claude Code Usage Analyzer
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: CLI tool that reads local Claude Code JSONL logs to produce daily, weekly, monthly, and session-level token and cost reports.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: @ccusage/codex — Codex CLI Usage Analyzer
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: CLI tool that reads local Codex CLI JSONL session logs to produce daily, monthly, and session-level token and cost reports.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: @ccusage/mcp — Usage Data MCP Server
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: MCP server that exposes ccusage data as agent-accessible tools for cost-aware agent loops and self-monitoring.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: Single-Agent LLMs Outperform Multi-Agent Systems Under Equal Thinking Token Budgets (Tran & Kiela)
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: Information-theoretic (Data Processing Inequality) argument that single-agent matches/beats multi-agent at equal token budget; build-vs-multi-agent decision input. Apr 2026 arXiv preprint, NOT peer-reviewed; scope: text-only multi-hop reasoning. Verify before relying.

economics_and_decision_frameworks.name: Agentic Much? Adoption of Coding Agents on GitHub (arXiv:2601.18341)
economics_and_decision_frameworks.relevance: 129,134-project empirical study estimating ~16-23% coding-agent adoption at file/commit level on GitHub by late 2025. Use as the sourced baseline instead of single-vendor PR-count marketing claims. Verified 2026-07-11.
